zealous.definition: showing great energy and enthusiasm for something
zealous.ex: She was a zealous supporter of environmental causes.
zealous.mnemonic: zealous – zeal wala banda har kaam josh se karta hai

zenith.ex: Her career reached its zenith last year.
zenith.mnemonic: zenith – ze-nith, sabse upar top point pe pahunchna

zany.ex: The film's zany humor kept everyone laughing.
zany.mnemonic: zany – 'Johnny' jaisa comedian, funny aur pagal

zoonic.definition: relating to animals or caused by animals
zoonic.ex: Some village diseases are zoonic, spread from animals to people.

zoo.definition: place where wild animals are kept for viewing
zoo.ex: We saw lions and tigers at the zoo.
zoo.mnemonic: zoo – 'ZO' matlab jaanwar, sab animals ek jagah

zeal.definition: great energy or enthusiasm for a cause
zeal.ex: She pursued her studies with remarkable zeal.

zealot.definition: fanatical, uncompromising follower of a cause
zealot.ex: The political zealot refused any compromise.
zealot.mnemonic: zealot – zeal se bhara fanatic bhakt

zoology.ex: He is studying zoology to become a wildlife biologist.
zoology.mnemonic: zoo-logy – zoo ke jaanwaron ka study

zoophobia.ex: His zoophobia made visiting the farm difficult.
zoophobia.mnemonic: zoophobia – zoo (animals) ka phobia, janwaron se darr

zoomorphism.definition: depicting gods or things with animal forms
zoomorphism.ex: Ancient Egyptian art shows zoomorphism in its animal-headed gods.
zoomorphism.mnemonic: zoomorphism – zoo=animal, cheez ko animal roop dena
